title: Misty forest dawn
prompt_en: 16:9. Sunbeams break through a misty pine forest at dawn, light rays moving slowly as fog drifts. Camera slowly pushes forward along a moss path. Green and gold tones, peaceful, natural.
prompt_zh: 16:9。黎明时阳光穿透薄雾笼罩的松林，雾气飘动，光束缓慢移动。镜头沿着苔藓小路缓慢前推。绿色与金色调，宁静自然。
why_it_works: Volumetric light plus drifting fog gives motion even with a slow camera.
